fix.item: Keep long-lived stdio processes within a 128 MB limit through bounded shared validation, cycle-free canonicalization and selective discovery. Bound fragmented frames, drain oversized frames, handle output backpressure and retain native idle polling cadence and route runtime diagnostics to stderr even with inherited stdout logging.

Distinguish malformed JSON-RPC envelopes, unknown methods and invalid method parameters, preserve IDs, ignore notifications and keep subsequent requests usable under the original SDK session and protocol-version rules.

Validate original tool-call JSON object and list types on stdio and authenticated HTTP. Accept omitted or empty-object input, reject arrays, null and scalars, and preserve empty and numeric-key mappings through nested action validation, encrypted plans, deferred jobs and replay. Adapt validated objects to Joomla form arrays only at native save; retain stored Registry JSON types in item read-back without widening model-visible content.
Map content-language identifier ordering to the native lang_id column and approved table aliases, preserving public id compatibility on fresh single-language sites.
Preserve JSON Schema object mappings and object-valued defaults through tool discovery, action search and descriptions, while retaining legitimate arrays and numeric object keys.

Preserve exact zero-based native list offsets and consistent totals for empty, partial-final, exact-end and beyond-end pages. Count filtered installer and cache collections before slicing and include live list acceptance in both installed tracks.

Deliver discovery replies exceeding the former 1 MiB encrypted-session bound while retaining principal isolation and compare-and-swap persistence. Return a bounded protocol error for oversized queued state and keep subsequent requests usable.

Default omitted custom field creation defaults to an empty string on API and native console transports, matching the administrator form and avoiding null-default backend DOM deprecations. Preserve explicit defaults and partial-update behavior.

Accept published, accessible Joomla custom field values in API article, content-category, contact and user create/update plans, including typed article tools and the optional com_fields alias. Reject unknown keys, expose runtime metadata in describe and freeze resolved fields with the approved plan.
Preserve installed template inheritance when creating site or administrator styles; bind verified parent metadata to the confirmed plan and refuse incomplete discovery before saving.

Persist native menu component IDs through an approved follow-up PATCH and verify raw stored collection values for create/update and changed component links. Preserve created identities and durable uncertain outcomes on later failure to prevent duplicate creation on replay.
Supply OctoJPack with the workflow's read-only GitHub token when the optional GIT_TOKEN secret is unset, so public tagged sources can be packaged.
Use the console plugin's independent-version installer fix in the installed Joomla and JCB checks.
Read MCP protocol identity and outbound API User-Agent versions from the native component manifest before and after installation.
Make the source ZIP directly installable with committed production dependencies, relocation-safe autoloading, catalogue seed and administrator licence.
Point component update discovery to the maintained native XML feed.
